snippet.title: Peter The Stash Hunter | Gameplay Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Play as Peter, bid on abandoned storage units at auction, loot the treasures inside, and sell them in your own shop. Peter the Stash Hunter is a single-player adventure that blends auction thrills, looter-RPG discovery, and shop management simulation.

Whislist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4638280/Peter_the_Stash_Hunter/
